items.title: Jindal Poly extends JPFL Films standstill with Brookfield-affiliate by 5 days to 30 Nov
items.text: Jindal Poly Films announced on 26 Nov that it extended its standstill with Project Holdings Fourteen and JPFL Films by 5 days, to 30 Nov 2026. The original 12-day standstill, signed 13 Nov, paused proceedings between the parties. No settlement was shown in the announcements listed on the page. The subsidiary JPFL Films houses the capacitor-film business, so the outcome of the dispute matters for the company's capacitor-film expansion.
